title: Scholars Fled West
sentences: Greek scholars fled to Italy, carrying ancient books with them.
Some had left long before 1453, as the empire shrank.
After the city fell, more refugees reached Venice, Florence and Rome.
Cardinal Bessarion, a Greek churchman living in Italy, collected hundreds of Greek manuscripts.
In 1468, he gave his library to Venice, the core of what became the Marciana Library.
Texts like these fed the Renaissance hunger for Greek learning.
